on_actions = {
	# Tokyo Express: stamp every relevant coastal state with the adopted sea regions
	# it touches, then elect each region's anchor state (the single map-icon holder).
	# Both effects are auto-generated by _modtools/Generate-TokyoExpressRegions.py and
	# are idempotent (arrays/flags are cleared first), so re-running on save load is
	# harmless.
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			# Numeric state scopes inside a scripted effect do NOT resolve from the
			# scopeless on_startup context (the set_state_flag fell through to GLOBAL,
			# observed in-game 2026-07-15). Diving into a country scope first matches
			# the proven pattern (decision complete_effects call the same style).
			JAP = {
				JAP_te_seed_regions_effect = yes
				JAP_te_refresh_anchors_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}

	# Anchors follow the front line: re-elect daily so a state captured or lost
	# moves the region's map icon to the best held coastal state.
	on_daily_JAP = {
		effect = {
			JAP_te_refresh_anchors_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
